projects.title: DevAssist MCP Server
projects.description: Production-grade tooling for context-aware engineering documents, RAG-powered codebase queries, and semantically grounded UML diagrams. Adopted by more than 10 engineering teams.
projects.overview: An internal developer-productivity platform that connects engineering context to document generation, codebase questions, and architecture diagrams through the Model Context Protocol.
highlights: Generates context-aware engineering documents and supports retrieval-augmented codebase queries.
Grounds UML generation in semantic code queries to reduce hallucinated relationships.
Contributed to a 100% increase in generated troubleshooting guides and incident postmortems.
Adopted by more than 10 engineering teams and continued beyond the original handoff.

projects.title: Gmail File System
projects.description: A FUSE filesystem that mounts a remote mailbox as a local directory, using IMAP to explore an unconventional storage backend.
projects.overview: A userspace filesystem that treats a Gmail mailbox as remote storage: subjects become filenames, message bodies become file contents, and a dedicated Gmail label acts as the filesystem root.
highlights: Implements familiar operations including ls, cd, mkdir, cat, write, rm, and rmdir through FUSE callbacks.
Uses libcurl to fetch messages, send mail, validate paths, enumerate folders, and delete files or directories over IMAP.
Includes custom string-processing helpers for parsing structured IMAP responses.
Runs as a mounted Linux filesystem and maps file creation or edits back to email operations.

projects.title: RISC-V Simulator
projects.description: A team-built simulator for 32-bit RISC-V execution, with pipelining, forwarding, cache configuration, and a step-through graphical interface.
projects.overview: A collaborative 32-bit RISC-V simulator that exposes machine-level execution step by step through both command-line and PyQt interfaces.
highlights: Supports 29 instructions with an extensible CSV-driven instruction definition system.
Models five execution stages, pipelining, data forwarding, pipeline registers, and cycle counts.
Provides configurable instruction and data caches, replacement policies, and branch prediction controls.
Produces detailed register, memory, forwarding, statistics, and execution-log outputs for analysis.

projects.title: GameDome

Implements chat through a Flask REST API whose source is included in the repository backend folder.
Uses local SQLite storage and shared preferences for authentication and leaderboard state.
Designed so contributors can add games or extend the app's features and animation system.
